title: Senior Manager-Campus Operations
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Title:**
Senior Manager-Campus Operations

**Department:**
Campus Operations

**Work Location:**
Sri City, Tada, Andhra Pradesh

**Reporting to:**
Associate Director

**Position:**
Full -Time

**Experience:**
3-5 Years

**Educational Qualification**
: BE/B. Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering

**Additional Requirements:**
Valid C Licence / applicable electrical licence

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage day-to-day MEP and technical operations covering Electrical, HVAC, Plumbing, Fire & Life Safety, DG, STP, RO, lifts and other critical infrastructure.
* Manage HT/LT electrical systems, including 11 kV / 33 kV incoming supply, HT yard, transformers, DGs and distribution systems.
* Manage and coordinate the technical/maintenance team, including manpower deployment, performance, training and 24x7 operational support.
* Plan and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance and ensure timely response and closure of breakdowns.
* Manage technical vendors, contractors, AMCs/OEMs and monitor SLA/KPI compliance.
* Maintain and monitor asset records, equipment history, warranties, AMC/CMC details and lifecycle/replacement requirements.
* Drive sustainability, energy conservation, utility optimization and cost-saving initiatives.
* Handle general administrative and operational coordination with internal departments to ensure smooth day-to-day campus operations.
* Identify and implement new initiatives and technologies to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
* Support CAPEX planning, technical evaluations, procurement and implementation of projects.
* Prepare and review operational MIS, maintenance reports, utility consumption and performance reports.
* Ensure statutory compliance, electrical safety, audits and required certifications.
* Analyse recurring failures and coordinate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and support the Associate Director in overall Campus Operations.

**What we are looking for:**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering – Essential.
* Valid C License / applicable electrical license – Essential.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in facilities, campus, institutional, commercial or similar operations.
* Hands-on experience in 11 kV / 33 kV HT systems and operations – Essential.
* Experience in MEP operations, maintenance and technical team management.
* Experience in vendor/contractor management and administration.
* Good communication, coordination, reporting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in a large residential/institutional campus will be preferred.
* Exposure to sustainability, energy management, asset management and CAPEX projects will be preferred.
* Master’s degree / MBA / M.Tech is desirable but not mandatory.

**Key Expectations:**

* The candidate should be proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to independently manage day-to-day technical operations and general administrative and operational requirements, anticipate potential issues and take timely corrective action.
* The candidate should be capable of analysing problems, developing practical solutions and ensuring effective resolution.
* The candidate should take ownership of critical infrastructure, maintenance and assigned operational responsibilities, while effectively coordinating the technical team, vendors and internal stakeholders. The role requires a strong focus on reliability, service quality, safety and operational efficiency, along with the ability to identify and implement opportunities for energy savings, cost optimisation and continuous improvement.
* The candidate should have good administrative, communication, coordination and reporting skills and work closely with the Associate Director to ensure the smooth and efficient functioning of Campus Operations.

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates should submit their resume, a cover letter detailing their relevant experience, and contact information
**careers@krea.edu.in**
with subject: Candidate Name\_ Application for Sr. Manager-Operations

**Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**

title: Store Incharge
description:
**Company Description**
Cholayil Private Limited is a leading and fast-growing FMCG company in India, recognized for its strong portfolio of Ayurveda and natural personal care products. The company’s flagship brand Medimix, launched in 1969, is complemented by well-known brands such as Cuticura, Krishna Thulasi, Dr. Sidhan’s Ayur Mix, Sadayush, Sadhev, and Jullaaha. With a global footprint across more than 35 countries, Cholayil has a prominent presence in regions including the Middle East, Far East, Europe, and Asia Pacific, and operates a joint venture in Kenya for the African market. The company also runs e-commerce platforms in India, the USA, Singapore, and Malaysia, with further expansion planned in the GCC region. Cholayil employs over 700 team members, with production plants in Tada (Andhra Pradesh) and Haridwar (Uttarakhand), and more details are available at www.cholayil.com and www.medimixayurveda.com.
  
**Role Description**
The Store Incharge role at Cholayil Private Limited is a full-time, on-site position based at the Tada production location. The Store Incharge will oversee daily store operations, including receipt, storage, and issuance of materials and finished goods, ensuring accurate inventory records and timely stock replenishment. Responsibilities include monitoring stock levels, coordinating with procurement and production teams, maintaining proper documentation, and ensuring compliance with company policies and safety standards. The role also involves implementing measures to prevent stock loss, maintaining cleanliness and organization in the store area, and supporting internal audits and periodic stock checks. The Store Incharge will work closely with cross-functional teams to support smooth supply chain operations and contribute to overall store efficiency and cost control.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong store management and inventory control skills, including experience in Store Management and Retail Loss Prevention.
* Ability to maintain high levels of Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction when interacting with internal and external stakeholders.
* Effective Communication skills for coordinating with production, procurement, logistics, and audit teams.
* Experience in FMCG or manufacturing environments, preferably in store or warehouse operations.
* Proficiency in using inventory management systems and basic MS Office (Excel, Word).
* Attention to detail, strong organizational abilities, and a focus on accuracy in documentation and record-keeping.
* Ability to work on-site in Tada, manage physical stock handling, and adhere to safety and hygiene standards.
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Commerce, or a related field is preferred.

title: Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title:**
Senior Engineer/Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME)

**Location:**

**Job Description**

The Senior Engineer / Deputy Manager - Machining (Projects & ME) oversees the process engineering, facility readiness, CNC programming, and tooling set-up for critical in-house engine components (Crankcase, Cylinder Head, Cylinder Barrel, Clutch/Magneto Covers, and Crankshafts). The incumbent analyzes engineering blueprints and tolerances to define operational sequences, set cutting parameters, and program Fanuc-controlled CNC machines. This role ensures shop-floor productivity by addressing bottleneck stations, managing special processes (Grinding, Industrial Washing, and Leak Testing), reducing cycle times, driving cost-saving initiatives, and coordinating predictive/preventive maintenance to maintain high facility availability across engine machining operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Blueprint Analysis & Process Planning:**
  Study engineering drawings, specs, and tolerances to determine operational sequences, parameters (speed, feed, cut depth/angle), and fixture setups for engine components.
* **CNC Programming & Tooling Setup:**
  Develop, edit, and optimize CNC programs using Fanuc controllers; select, align, and secure workholding fixtures, cutting tools, and accessories.
* **Special Process & Line Management:**
  Oversee specialized machining operations, including precision grinding, industrial component washing, and high-pressure leak testing equipment.
* **Line Balancing & Bottleneck Optimization:**
  Analyze cycle time, takt time, and throughput to identify critical bottleneck stations and optimize work allocation across the shop floor.
* **Facility Readiness & Maintenance:**
  Support predictive/preventive maintenance routines, ensure continuous machine availability, and resolve field failures and production line issues promptly.
* **Productivity & Continuous Improvement:**
  Drive cost-reduction initiatives, improve line productivity, and apply structured problem-solving methodologies to resolve quality and operational non-conformances.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Automotive Engineering.
* **Experience:**
  12+ years of hands-on machining process engineering experience within the automotive OEM or engine manufacturing sector (preferably two-wheeler or light vehicle IC engines).
* **Core Competencies:**
  Fanuc CNC programming, precision component machining, special process machine handling (Grinding/Washing/Leak Testing), takt time optimization, and shop-floor troubleshooting.

title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager  - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)
description:
**Position Title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Vehicle Assembly (Projects & ME)**

**Location:**
Satyavedu

**Job Description:**

The Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager - Manufacturing Engineering (Vehicle Assembly) is responsible for driving line balancing, process optimization, layout designing, and facility commissioning across vehicle assembly operations. Sitting at the intersection of process engineering and Industry 4.0, this role leads the procurement and integration of tooling, jigs, fixtures, Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) testing facilities, and Low-Cost Automation (LCA) solutions. The incumbent executes line trials, implements ergonomic improvements (REBA/RULA), drives PFMEA and quality non-conformance root cause analysis, and embeds MES/IIoT traceability (Vehicle Genealogy) to ensure high-efficiency, safe, and cost-effective assembly operations up to final handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Line Balancing & Process Optimization:**
  Conduct time studies and workflow analyses to eliminate Non-Value-Added (NVA) activities, balancing assembly lines to boost efficiency and operational productivity.
* **Facility & Tooling Development:**
  Design plant layouts for expansions and handle end-to-end procurement (RFQ to DAP trials, site installation, and commissioning) for tools, jigs, fixtures, Poka-Yokes, and ABS testing facilities.
* **Industry 4.0 & Digital Manufacturing:**
  Integrate Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), IIoT networks, and Vehicle Genealogy tracking while executing Low-Cost Automation (LCA) and ergonomic upgrades (REBA/RULA).
* **Quality Governance & PFMEA:**
  Collaborate with Quality to resolve process non-conformances using 8D/A3 tools, update PFMEAs and Control Plans, and create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* **Cross-Functional & Packaging Support:**
  Provide daily shop-floor engineering support, resolve line bottlenecks, drive VAVE/cost-reduction projects, and oversee CKD packaging standards and material handling systems.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Mechatronics Engineering
* **Experience:**
  6–10 years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering / process engineering within automotive vehicle assembly environments (OEMs or major Tier-1 system integrators)
* **Core Competencies:**
  End-to-end RFQ-to-commissioning execution, MES/IIoT integration, ABS facility testing, line balancing, and ergonomic workstation design

description:

Job Number #176870 - Sricity, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Who We Are**
Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
  
  
Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
  
  
**Role Summary & Purpose**
Championing product integrity and consumer trust, you will architect and deploy the site Quality Master Plan and Quality Manual across Colgate-Palmolive’s high-speed Sri City manufacturing plant. You will drive a rigorous 'Right First Time' operational culture by auditing manufacturing systems, resolving Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) through CAPA, and leading technical bundle validations. Partnering directly with shop-floor operations and global audit teams, you eliminate process variation and customer complaints. Based on-site in Sri City, you ensure every toothbrush manufactured meets world-class quality and safety standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, document, and maintain the site Quality Master Plan, Quality Manual, and Global Quality standards compliance.
* Conduct internal audit programs and participate in Divisional and Corporate Quality Audits to evaluate site quality effectiveness.
* Lead root cause analysis and CAPA closures for all Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) in coordination with plant leadership.
* Manage the online Customer Response System (CRS), analyzing consumer complaints to drive continuous improvement.
* Monitor shop-floor quality KPIs and process capability to ensure all finished products fulfill KRSs (Key Release Specification) prior to market release.
* Deliver structured technical training and coaching to Quality Technicians, Operators, and plant line teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science or Technical stream (B.Sc / M.Sc / B.Tech) from a recognized university.
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of core experience in the FMCG industry with Quality & Production management responsibility.
* Quality Methodologies: Proven expertise in developing Quality Manuals, executing CAPA, NCR resolution, and process capability monitoring.
* Systems: Working knowledge of SAP (QM module), online CRS complaint management, and quality audit frameworks.

**Preferred Qualification & Experience**

* Industry: Experience in high-volume consumer goods (CPG/FMCG), oral care, or precision plastics manufacturing.
* Audit Expertise: Familiarity with international subsidiary benchmarking, cGMP, and EOHS site standards.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional training, coaching, and people facilitation capabilities with a strong decision-making mindset.
* Commercial Mindset: Understanding of plant financials, product commercialization bundles, and target cost delivery.

title: Overhead Equipment Manager
description:
**Company Description**
ML Enterprises LLP is a growing organization focused on delivering reliable, high-quality solutions across its operational and engineering activities. The company values safety, efficiency, and adherence to industry standards, especially in the management and maintenance of critical infrastructure and equipment. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their responsibilities while collaborating with colleagues to improve processes and outcomes. ML Enterprises LLP offers opportunities for professional development, stable employment, and the chance to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact on day-to-day operations. The work environment emphasizes integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Role Description**
The Overhead Equipment Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Sullurpeta, responsible for overseeing the installation, operation, maintenance, and inspection of overhead equipment and related systems. The role includes planning and scheduling maintenance activities, coordinating with technicians and contractors, and ensuring all work follows safety regulations and technical standards. The manager will monitor equipment performance, troubleshoot issues, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports on asset condition, maintenance history, and required upgrades. Day-to-day tasks also involve managing inventory of spare parts, optimizing equipment uptime, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support project timelines and operational reliability. This role requires hands-on oversight in the field, regular site visits, and proactive risk identification to prevent equipment failures.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of overhead equipment systems, mechanical components, and basic electrical principles.
* Experience in maintenance planning, asset management, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in safety practices, risk assessment, and compliance with relevant industry standards and regulations.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications for installation and maintenance activities.
* Effective organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple tasks and maintenance schedules.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with teams, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Competence in using maintenance software or spreadsheets for record-keeping, reporting, and tracking assets.
* Previous experience in industrial, utilities, rail, or infrastructure environments is highly beneficial.
* Relevant technical diploma or degree in mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering (or equivalent experience).
* Ability to work on-site in Sullurpeta and perform regular field inspections and equipment checks.
